data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: exercise
sections.summary: Physical activity done to keep the body fit and healthy.

senses.definition: physical activity done to keep the body fit, strong, and healthy
examples: She goes for a walk every morning as part of her daily exercise.

sections.question: health
sections.summary: The general condition of your body or mind, especially in terms of being well or ill.

senses.definition: the general condition of the body or mind; the state of being free from illness or injury
examples: Eating well and sleeping enough is essential for good health.

answers.answer: Health is a type of medicine.

sections.question: hospital
sections.summary: A place where people who are ill or injured receive medical care and treatment.

senses.definition: a large institution where people who are ill, injured, or having operations receive medical care and treatment
examples: She was taken to hospital immediately after the accident.

answers.answer: He was taken to hospital after the accident.
A hospital is a type of insurance.

sections.question: injury
sections.summary: Physical damage done to part of the body as a result of an accident or attack.

senses.definition: physical damage done to part of the body as a result of an accident, fall, or attack
examples: The footballer had to rest for six weeks because of a knee injury.

answers.answer: He suffered a serious injury during the match.
An injury is a healthy habit.

sections.question: insurance
sections.summary: An arrangement in which you pay money regularly to a company that will pay your costs if something bad happens.

senses.definition: an arrangement in which you pay regular amounts to a company and they pay your costs if you have an accident, become ill, or suffer a loss
examples: You should always buy travel insurance before going abroad.

answers.answer: She bought health insurance last year.
Insurance is a type of hospital room.

sections.question: medication
sections.summary: A drug or medicine prescribed by a doctor to treat an illness or condition.

senses.definition: a drug or medicine used to treat a medical condition or illness, usually prescribed by a doctor
examples: She takes daily medication to control her blood pressure.

sections.question: nutrition
sections.summary: The process of eating the right kinds of food to stay healthy; the study of food and health.

senses.definition: the process of eating the right food for health and growth; the study of how food affects the body
examples: Proper nutrition during pregnancy is very important for the baby's development.

answers.answer: Good nutrition is essential for children.

sections.question: policy
sections.summary: A written contract with an insurance company specifying what is covered.

senses.definition: a written contract with an insurance company that sets out exactly what is covered in return for regular payments
examples: Read the policy carefully before you sign to understand what is covered.

answers.answer: The insurance policy covers dental treatment.
A policy is a medical wound.

sections.question: prescription
sections.summary: A written instruction from a doctor allowing a patient to get medicine from a pharmacy.

senses.definition: a written instruction from a doctor or medical professional that allows a patient to obtain a specific medicine from a pharmacy
examples: The doctor gave her a prescription for antibiotics.

answers.answer: You need a prescription to buy this medicine.
A prescription is a type of injury.

sections.question: reaction
sections.summary: A response by the body to a substance, drug, or treatment, often negative or unwanted.

senses.definition: a response by the body to a substance, drug, or treatment, often an unwanted or unexpected one
examples: Some people have a reaction to certain antibiotics, such as a rash or itching.

answers.answer: She had a reaction to the medication.
A reaction is a healthy diet.
